feature: Dropping a picture hands you the pointer
summary: Drag a picture in from the Finder and you are left holding the pointer with the picture picked, so nudging it into place works straight away instead of drawing a shape over it. Pasting has done this since yesterday; now a drop does too, on the canvas and on a row in the layers list.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next. Nothing to turn on: the Experiments switch is called "A new picture hands you the pointer" and is already on.

try.do: Open any picture, then press R for the rectangle tool.
Drag a PNG out of the Finder and let it go in the middle of the canvas.
Without touching the tool bar, drag the picture you just dropped somewhere else. It should move, not draw.
Press R again, drop a second picture, then press Command Z once.
Look at the tool bar: the rectangle should be back in your hand, and Command Shift Z takes the pointer up again.
Press R once more and let a picture go on a row in the layers list instead of on the canvas.
Draw a marquee with M, then drop a picture inside it: the marquee clears rather than sitting over the new picture.

evaluate: When the pointer takes over after a drop, do you notice it happening, or does it just feel like the drop worked?
Is getting your rectangle back on Command Z what you expect, or would you rather keep the pointer once you have it?
Dropping on a layers row lands the picture behind the ones above it, so its handles can be half hidden. Is that confusing right after a drop?
Placing a picture off the Library shelf now hands the pointer over too. Right, or should the shelf leave your tool alone?
Should the marquee really go when a picture drops inside it?
rough: Redo puts the picture back and takes the pointer up, but it does not re-pick the layer, so you get the pointer with nothing selected. That is how paste already behaved and it was left alone rather than changed under this task.
Letting a picture go into a slot of a collage is untouched: it fills a slot inside a layer that is already there, so there is no new picture to move and nothing to hand the pointer over for.
The paste switch was widened rather than a second one added, so paste and drop cannot be set to disagree. Its name changed to "A new picture hands you the pointer".
Verified live: the probe holds Screen Recording, so both shots are real captures of the window from Scripts/playtest/drop-hands-you-the-pointer-walk.json.
